name: Briar Glen shut door
notes: The door of a Briar Glen building whose interior is not built yet (mw-e24.2): a closed shop or house with nobody answering. No key exists, so it shows the locked prompt; a thief with lockpicks can pick it (tier 1). The interior beads (mw-e24.5, mw-e24.7, mw-e24.8, mw-e24.9, mw-e24.11) replace each of these doors with a transition.
